signal: Move Concierge acquired LiveBy in Dec 2025, partnered with Fathom Holdings, and launched a direct-to-consumer platform plus a Smart Security division

email.body1:
Daria, saw Moved acquired LiveBy and launched the direct-to-consumer platform and Smart Security division.

Opening that many new motions at once usually means more accounts and partners in play than the team can cover, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Moved off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to cover the new lines
email.body2:
Daria, quick follow-up for Moved.

With a new consumer line and the Smart Security division live, the number of segments your team has to generate pipeline for just multiplied, faster than you can hire BD reps to cover them. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings each line needs to pull its weight.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings Moved needs across the new motions, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Daria, last bit of proof for Moved.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire reps fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Moved's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Daria, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline across the new lines without adding headcount isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Launching a consumer platform and a new division at once is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Moved either way.
